🎤 Speaker announcement

A very special one. Jo Dalton is joining Alma Summit 2026 🌟

Jo is a Founding Alma, which makes this particularly meaningful, and many of you will recognise her from our Growth Hacks series earlier this year where she spoke on building the right leadership team and board at the right time. Now she's back, this time in the moderator's chair.

Jo is founder of JD&Co, one of Europe's leading Founder Advisory and Executive Search firms, which she built from her kitchen in 2011 as a lone founder with no funding and has grown into an advisory firm working with some of the fastest growing challenger brands in the world. She is also an angel investor in more than a dozen scaling businesses, with a focus on sustainability, the circular economy and health and wellbeing, and brings nearly two decades of experience advising and building boards and leadership teams for disruptive, high-growth brands.

She will be leading a conversation on the transitions founders rarely talk about publicly: the breakups, the exits, the pivots in leadership that define whether a company makes it or not. Few moderators will bring as much first-hand context to that discussion as Jo.

If this is the kind of conversation you want to be in the room for, join us on 17 June at Town Hall by Bottaccio 🙌

📅 17 June 2026
⏰ From 1pm til late
📍 Town Hall by Bottaccio, London
🎟 Free, donation encouraged
